title: Emit model metadata change-events with diff + actor/timestamp (create/update/deprecate)
author: Michael Nguyen
description:
Context: We need a canonical, auditable source of truth for model/version changes to drive the customer-visible model changelog and to support enterprise change-management. Today we mutate model metadata records directly and rely on ad-hoc messaging; there is no durable event stream describing what changed, who did it, and when. This PR adds first-class change-event emission for model metadata create/update/deprecate operations.

What this PR does: 1) Introduces a stable event envelope (event_id, event_type, occurred_at, actor) for all metadata mutations. 2) Adds metadata diffing that produces a structured list of changed paths plus before/after values (with redaction for secrets + internal-only note fields). 3) Persists the event to the registry DB for audit/retention and also publishes to the internal event bus topic used by the changelog generator. 4) Provides idempotency guards to avoid duplicate emission on retries.

Event model (v1): - event_id: ULID (lexicographically sortable) generated at write-time. - event_type: model_record.created | model_record.updated | model_record.deprecated (record covers both model_id + version_id scopes; see notes below). - occurred_at: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at commit time. - actor: {actor_type=user|service, actor_id, actor_email (optional), source_ip (optional), auth_subject (optional)}. - target: {model_id, version_id, environment=hosted|dedicated|private, registry_region}. - diff: list of entries {path, op=set|unset|add|remove, before, after}. For map/list fields we emit leaf paths where possible; for large arrays (compatibility matrices) we emit a hash summary + top-level path only.

Notes / constraints: - Redaction: this PR redacts fields under internal_notes/* and any KMS/key material fields. We also truncate long strings at 2KB to keep event size bounded. (A stricter public allowlist is coming in a follow-up when we wire customer-facing templating; see ENG-4926.) - Scope: create/update/deprecate flows in the HTTP API + internal admin job paths. Deprecate is represented as an update with validation invariants, but emitted as its own event_type to simplify downstream templates/workflows. - Storage + publish: events are written in the same transaction as the metadata mutation (outbox table + publisher). A background publisher reads the outbox and publishes to topic model-registry.metadata-changes with at-least-once semantics.

API changes: No new public endpoints in this PR. Internal-only admin endpoint can query recent events for debugging: GET /internal/v1/model-events?model_id=...&version_id=... (gated behind admin RBAC).

Testing: - Unit tests for diffing behavior (scalar fields, nested structs, map keys, list append/remove). - Unit tests for redaction/truncation. - Integration test that verifies an update triggers exactly one outbox row + publish attempt, and retry is idempotent.

Rollout plan: - Behind feature flag EMIT_MODEL_METADATA_EVENTS (default OFF). - Enable in staging for the changelog generator integration tests; then gradually enable in prod after confirming topic consumers + SIEM export do not regress.

Example emitted event (sanitized): event_id=01HQW2E4J2WJ0F2S5H1TQJ0K9N event_type=model_record.updated occurred_at=2026-02-02T19:14:33Z actor_type=user actor_id=u_7c3... target.model_id=rw-llama3-8b target.version_id=2026-02-01 diff=[{path:"runtime.context_window",op:"set",before:"8192",after:"16384"},{path:"compat.tool_calling",op:"set",before:"beta",after:"ga"}]

Follow-ups: - Public field allowlist + customer-safe rendering (ENG-4926, PR in progress). - Additional event types for rollback/supersede once approvals/publish are live (control-plane PRs). - Backfill for historical changes pre-migration is out of scope for this PR.

review_conversation: Quentin Harris: Can we avoid emitting full before/after for very large compatibility matrices? This will blow up event size + downstream storage.

Michael Nguyen (author): Yep. Updated diffing to emit leaf paths where possible; for large arrays/maps we emit top-level path + sha256(before)/sha256(after) summaries, and cap total diff entries at 250 with a 'diff_truncated=true' marker in the event metadata.
Jordan Lee: Redaction looks good, but internal_notes/* is not the only internal-only field. Can we at least ensure we never include anything under *.customer_messaging_draft or *.support_notes?

Michael Nguyen (author): Added additional redaction patterns for support_notes and customer_messaging_draft, plus a test fixture that verifies we redact known internal-only fields. Long-term plan is a positive allowlist for public rendering in ENG-4926.
Connor O'Brien: We need deterministic ordering for generator templates and for comparing events. ULIDs help but can you also sort diff entries by path so output is stable?
Michael Nguyen (author): Done. Diff entries are now sorted lexicographically by path before persistence/publish. Added a golden test to ensure stable ordering.
Chloe Martin: For Console integration later we’ll need to query by model_id/version_id efficiently. Did you add indexes on the events table?
Michael Nguyen (author): Added composite index (model_id, version_id, occurred_at desc). Also added a lightweight internal query endpoint (admin-only) for debugging and seeded it in staging.
Quentin Harris: LGTM after the size cap + stable ordering changes.
Jordan Lee: Approved with the added redaction tests. Please keep follow-up issue for allowlist on the changelog generator side.
Connor O'Brien: Approved. Rollout flag default OFF is a must; thanks for wiring it.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Michael Nguyen
release_notes: Internal: model registry now emits auditable metadata change-events (diff + actor/timestamp/event_id) for create/update/deprecate operations; gated by EMIT_MODEL_METADATA_EVENTS flag.
